candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get diarrhoea wey don last for 3 days. E no dey convulse now and dem no talk say e don convulse before. E no be lethargic and e dey conscious. E no fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get blood for stool. E no dey restless or irritable. If I pinch e skin, e dey normal. E eye dey sunken. E no get cough or difficult breathing. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
